title: CPU and GPU power
line: The TDP, boost, governor and GPU limits the Power page and Auto TDP set.
risk_note: A day-to-day setting with checked values; the original is always saved and put back.

changes.target: cpufreq, intel_pstate / amd_pstate, GPU frequency and firmware-attributes power limits (fixes/power-tune/README.md)
changes.detail: Each value is checked against what the kernel offers; the original is recorded first.
Held while a game runs on Intel handhelds where it would overwrite the TDP; it starts again by itself.

undo: `set restore` writes every recorded original back; remove also forgets them.

probe.what: A setting, not a workaround: status says whether this handheld has the control at all (applies=yes).
